name: How can I prepare my home for stair repair work?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for stair repair work?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home for stair repair work, ensure the area around the staircase is clear of furniture, decorations, and any personal items that could obstruct the work or be damaged. If possible, make arrangements for an alternative route to access different levels of your home, as the stairs may be inaccessible. Covering nearby floors and furniture with drop cloths can help protect them from dust and debris. Frasheski Construction will coordinate with you regarding access, parking, and specific site preparation needs before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for stair repair by clearing the work area, planning an alternative route for access, and covering nearby items. Frasheski Construction will coordinate specific site needs.
